comments.value: I attempted to edit the post so it properly said build 1912, but it wont let me ammend the post so Im putting it down here for now.

details:
The HUD is just straight up dookie cheek buns. Did someone with a phone-app credential background made this? 

Scrap it all, most importantly no icon should be persistent on my screen and be intrusive like that, the F4 button is the worst choice to have a facecam render as if I ALT + F4 then it pops up and shows up for the next session...? Who thought this was acceptable?

Not to mention mic now being permanent in the corner of your screen same as the 3 menu lines in the top left is a big eyesore even when it's on minimal HUD, the only option beyond that IS TO DISABLE HUD ENTIRELY which makes it impossible to see invites, notifications, or even know if youre talking. Include the fact that all interact menus are 5x larger and take up more space on your screen (wtf happened to the keyboard thing? why is it now just the input screen at like 20x scale and no "keyboard" anymore?).

Here's what players want:

+Original HUD System; Leave it alone, dont touch it, EVER. It's worked flawlessly since the literal beginning of the game beyond the minor tweaks when you changed menu's and the UI for the 1st/2nd time. The current non-beta HUD is the baseline that every iteration should strive to be as similar to as possible.

+New Modern HUD System: Fully Customizable in placement and amount of buttons/what buttons are present.

This isn't a case of "oh players are just reacting because they dont like change", someone deliberately made an extremely horrible user experience that annoyed me and from what I clearly see a lot of others to post about this, and thought that it would be a great addition. Revert it immediately.
title: 1140? [Open-Beta HUD is HORRIBLE]
